candidates.name: Holman, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Toilet Partitions and Hardware product page says it supplies and installs commercial toilet partitions in Jacksonville and Northeast Florida with an in-house installation crew; homepage says 'We sell and install all our products'.
candidates.review_source: BBB: A+ rating, accredited since 2015, 0 customer reviews; BBB lists FL DBPR license CBC1258919 and City of Jacksonville 503260000 (unverified by BBB)
candidates.reason: Jacksonville-based Division 8/10/12 specialty contractor that explicitly supplies and installs commercial toilet partitions across Northeast Florida and Southeast Georgia. It is also a dealer for many brands we sell (ASI, Bobrick, Scranton, Bradley, Metpar, AAMCO), so buy-around risk is high.
red_flags: Dealer for the same brands Next Partitions sells (strong buy-around risk)
No project photos on the partitions page

license.name: Holman, Inc.
license.registry: Florida DBPR licensee search (myfloridalicense.com/wl11.asp) and City of Jacksonville Construction Trades Qualifying Board license lookup (contrades.coj.net/Licenses.aspx)
license.note: Both official lookups work only as interactive search forms (DBPR's form-based search; CTQB ASP.NET form with no name parameter in the URL), so I couldn't run an automated lookup. The city's contractor license search page names both as the places to check, plus the Duval County business tax search (county-taxes.net/fl-duval/business-tax). Company site (https://www.holman-inc.com/) says it sells and installs toilet partitions ('We sell and install all our products') and is 'Bonded and Insured', with no license number. Base city Jacksonville, FL. Company phone 904-781-4531 (header also shows 904-467-8779). Next step: look up by hand at DBPR and CTQB by name.
